description: This file implements the SpdySessionPool class, managing SPDY protocol sessions including creation, lookup, request handling, and session lifecycle management within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: SpdySessionPool
classes.description: Manages SPDY sessions, handling creation, lookup, request queuing, and lifecycle events within the network stack.

classes.name: SpdySessionRequest
classes.description: Represents a request for a SPDY session, including delegate callbacks and request parameters.

methods.name: CreateAvailableSessionFromSocketHandle
methods.description: Creates a SPDY session from a socket handle, initializing it and inserting into the pool.

methods.name: CreateAvailableSessionFromSocket
methods.description: Creates a SPDY session from an existing socket, initializing and inserting it into the pool.

methods.name: FindAvailableSession
methods.description: Finds an existing available SPDY session matching the key, considering websocket support and pooling options.

methods.name: RequestSession
methods.description: Requests a SPDY session for a given key, possibly queuing the request if none are available.

methods.name: OnHostResolutionComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of host resolution, updating session aliasing and pooling based on resolved addresses.

methods.name: MakeSessionUnavailable
methods.description: Marks a session as unavailable, removing it from the pool and alias mappings.

methods.name: RemoveUnavailableSession
methods.description: Removes a session that is no longer available from the pool.

methods.name: CloseCurrentSessions
methods.description: Closes all current SPDY sessions, optionally only idle ones.

methods.name: CloseCurrentIdleSessions
methods.description: Closes all current idle SPDY sessions.

methods.name: CloseAllSessions
methods.description: Closes all SPDY sessions managed by the pool.

methods.name: MakeCurrentSessionsGoingAway
methods.description: Marks all current sessions as going away, closing them gracefully.

methods.name: UpdatePendingRequests
methods.description: Updates and notifies pending session requests when a new session becomes available.

methods.name: RemoveRequestInternal
methods.description: Removes a specific request from the request set and updates the request map.
